comparison.objective: Register an aluminium workpiece flat and square against two fixture stops; the candidate changes and locks a stop setting.
comparison.physical_skill: Planar placement, handoff, and gap closure against an L-stop, not coaxial screw-and-nut manipulation.
comparison.success_condition: Four measured gaps, flatness, and squareness meet stated tolerances; candidate instead measures opening angle, nut seating, drift, and cycles.
comparison.reason: Contacting fixed datum faces does not test preserving an adjustable threaded setting.
